title:
Stage 1 forge tier — FOUNDATION ONLY (increments 0 and 1 of .design/stage1-forge-tier-kickoff-plan.md). Authoritative spec: .design/stage1-forge-tier.md (REQ-1..REQ-10, AC-1..AC-14); the plan sequences. Follow the ACToR read-write-verify-commit loop. Commit per increment (cite the REQ + thermite-design section). Self-verify before each commit and revert any change that fails. If low on time or budget, STOP at an increment boundary and report which increments landed; the branch is resumable.

SCOPE: only increments 0 and 1. OUT OF SCOPE (do not build): REQ-3 surface syntax, REQ-4 covenant LOGIC (inhabit/falsify), REQ-5 battery, REQ-6 anti-Goodhart, REQ-7 goal/fill UX, REQ-8b relax engine route, REQ-9 lemma library, all stage 2/3 work.

INCREMENT 0 (REQ-8a, independent — land first): add the two relax spine lemmas r_relax_sound and rencode_sound (metatheory section 7) in a single isolated Mathlib-importing island module under lean/Thermite/. Full Mathlib is already pinned via the lean-smt dependency (toolchain v4.29.0); keep the core denotation path Mathlib-free. Extend the make audit axiom probe to cover both new lemmas, allowed-axiom set unchanged. AUDIT FINDING F4 PREREQUISITE (see the trust-audit-93d3cbc0 knowledge page and the plan): add a CI job running lake build plus the axiom probe (today CI is Rust-only; the Lean spine builds only in local make audit), and pin lean-smt to a SHA in lean/lakefile.toml (today inputRev is the main branch). Self-verify: lake build green; make audit axiom probe covers both lemmas; the probe runs in CI.

INCREMENT 1 (REQ-1 + REQ-2 + the REQ-4 Engine-signature change — the foundation that gates 2a-2f):
1. Q-KBSIGNAL probe FIRST: determine whether Verus/Lean emit a textually-distinct kernel/elaboration-budget exhaustion signal versus solver rlimit (tv_signal.rs today has only is_rlimit_signal; both currently fall into VerusTimeout). If a distinct signal exists, add a second discriminator in the same one-shared-helper pattern with a negative test proving the two cannot be confused. If none exists, detect KernelBudget via a forge-side elaboration wall-clock timeout wrapper at the Q4 budget (30s per clause). Record in the commit which path the probe selected. (AC-2)
2. Seven-verdict CERT-LEVEL enum (Proved, Counterexample, RealWitness, CovenantRefuted, Stuck with goals, KernelBudget, Timeout) as a NEW separate type in forge/src — NOT arms of engine::Verdict. Map ONLY Proved, Counterexample, Timeout from the three-arm engine::Verdict by an exhaustive match with no wildcard arm. The other four are produced upstream by later increments; for the foundation define the variants, their construction sites, and serde, but do not build the producing logic for RealWitness, CovenantRefuted, or Stuck. No Unknown may survive into a certificate. serde round-trip tests for all seven. (AC-1)
3. never-converts-silently hermetic tests in the degrade.rs closure-instrumented style (the counterexample_never_degrades pattern): assert CovenantRefuted and Counterexample never invoke any lower-ladder or retry closure, and that no code path constructs Proved from a non-Proved value. Construct the variants directly in tests where producers are not yet built. (AC-3)
4. Certificate schema v2: per-clause engine, trust, and verdict fields, ADDITIVE over the existing Certificate struct in manifest.rs using serde default plus skip_serializing_if (the engine_attribution precedent), so oracle_subset stays byte-identical for all seven conformance golden certs. Verify byte-identity explicitly. (AC-4)
5. REQ-2 axiom-gate hoist: lift the STANDARD_AXIOM_ALLOWLIST check (subset of propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) from the interactive replay tier (engine.rs today) into a shared certifying step invoked on EVERY Lean discharge path including auto tiers a and b, which today return Unknown on export failure with no axiom check. Preserve every existing ExportRefusal variant and add a test for each. Do NOT redo the exporter soundness gates — undefined-callee, bool-result, capture-safety are already shipped (#243-#246, #253, #264). (AC-5)
6. REQ-2 correspondence table: author the new exporter-surface correspondence table under .design/verified/ (extending the Table 4 EXP drift-tripwire discipline) and repoint the existing doc-drift route for forge/src/lean_export.rs (the gate is already built, #258; do not build it). Pin its audited-sha. Stays inspection-tier (does not close audit finding F3). (AC-6)
7. REQ-4 Engine-signature change ONLY (NOT the covenant logic): Engine::discharge gains a non-optional covenant-record parameter, threaded through VerusEngine, LeanEngine, and every call site (check.rs, contract_tv.rs, exec_tv.rs, body_tv.rs) so the sites are touched once. Introduce the covenant-record type; current programs legitimately carry a no-covenant-declared record (truthful — witness syntax is REQ-3 and not present yet, so this is not a stub). Wire CovenantRefuted as a Counterexample-class hard fail in the degrade.rs LadderAction. The covenant-before-burn ENFORCEMENT and the inhabit/falsify producer are increment 2b and OUT OF SCOPE here.

PER-INCREMENT GAUNTLET before each commit: cargo test -p the crate; cargo clippy -p the crate --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --check; for Lean work lake build green and the make audit axiom probe extended; AND forge check over conformance still matches all seven golden certs with oracle_subset byte-identical. No stubs or TODOs; fix warnings rather than suppress.

SCOPE GUARDS: certificates additive only (no oracle_subset change for v1 items); do NOT change the cage or combinator menu (thermite-spec REGISTRY signatures untouched); do NOT flip the README or docs headline (that is the G1 gate only, R-GATE-1); never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json. Resolved, do not re-litigate: Q-ORACLE, Q-BURN. One branch feature/stage1-forge-tier; open ONE PR for the foundation.
